newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle quiet, bid $113/dressed- trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle quiet, bid $113/dressed- trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Thursday were quiet, with bids reported at $113.00 per cwt but no sales reported following Wednesday's active trade, market sources said.
The $113.00 was down $1.00 from the bulk of Wednesday's sales. Asking levels were $114.00 to $115.00.
About 31,000 head sold Wednesday, which some sources said could be the end of this week's trade.
Showlists were mostly depleted but those cattle left were unfinished and could use extra days on feed, sources said.
